name: Tiefentalalm
beschreibung:
History

The website tiefentalalm-pitztal.at presents the Tiefentalalm as an alpine pasture of the Neururer family, at 1880 metres above sea level, in the mountain landscape of the Kaunergrat, high above the Pitztal, with a view of the Rofelewand and the Gsallkopf, directly on the Gschwandbach. A founding or construction year is not given by the page. On retrieval the homepage stated that the alpine pasture is in winter sleep, is currently closed and looks forward to a reunion in summer 2027. It was said not to be reachable by telephone; contact by email. The page prints the telephone number +43 664 537 80 50 and beside it a digit sequence that is obviously in the form of a placeholder. The placeholder digits are not adopted here as a telephone number. The data set also contains +43 664 2009588. Which number applies outside the season is not stated unambiguously by the closure notice, because the house writes at the same time that it is not reachable by telephone. The email is office@tiefentalalm-pitztal.at. Older texts that place the alpine pasture at 1500 metres and in the district of Kufstein contradict the alpine-pasture website, which names 1880 metres, the Kaunergrat and the Pitztal.

Getting there

The ascent begins in the district Scheibe at the Gasthof zur Einkehr at 1382 metres above sea level. From there one crosses the bridge and follows the farm track or path uphill. The page names 498 metres of elevation and about 1.5 to 2 hours of walking time up to 1880 metres. A road approach up to the alpine pasture, a car park or a cable car are not described. It is a footpath.

Tips

In the summer months the alpine pasture is intended as the destination of a hike or as a place to stop. Named are Tiroler Schmankerl, a hearty snack, sweet alpine-pasture dishes and drinks, a large sun terrace and a playground in the immediate vicinity. Staying overnight is possible only on request: one room with four double beds for a maximum of 8 people, bedding is provided, breakfast is included. Expressly: no electricity and no shower. The 2027 season should be confirmed by email before the ascent, as long as the closure notice until summer 2027 is online. An overnight stay without this enquiry is not provided for according to the page.
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine pasture of the Neururer family at 1880 metres above the Pitztal, in winter sleep until summer 2027. Overnight stays only on request, without electricity and without a shower.
